description.zh:
黑名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
- **src**：String类型，必选，黑名单IP。
description.en:
A JSON string that contains the IP addresses to remove from the blacklist. The string has the following structure:

- **src**: The IP address to remove. This is a required string.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.

> Call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

title.zh: 删除针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-auto-cc-blacklist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --query-type example-string --blacklist src_:_198.51.XX.XX_,_src_:_198.52.XX.XX --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
